استقرضا (form X)

# اُسْتُقْرِضَا (ustuqriḍā) /us.tuq.ri.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
# اِسْتَقْرِضَا (istaqriḍā) /is.taq.ri.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَقْرَضَ (istaqraḍa)
